title: Sam Sheep and the Fuzzy Cloud
description: A little lamb tries to catch a cloud in the sky and learns to enjoy the simple wonders around him.
character_reference: a fluffy little lamb with bouncy white wool curls and soft floppy black ears

scenes.narration: Sam lay on his back in the meadow, watching fluffy white clouds float lazily overhead.
scenes.visual: lying comfortably on green grass looking straight up, relaxed happy expression, wide open blue sky above

scenes.narration: He decided he wanted to catch his very own cloud and keep it in his pocket.
scenes.visual: sitting up abruptly with excited wide eyes, holding one hoof up toward the sky in determination

scenes.narration: Sam climbed up the highest grassy hill, stretching his little hooves as high as they could go.
scenes.visual: standing on tiptoes atop a green mound, stretching front legs upward toward the sky, windy breeze rustling wool

scenes.narration: No matter how high he reached, the soft white clouds stayed far out of his grasp.
scenes.visual: dropping hooves in slight disappointment, looking up with a puzzled pout, sunny pasture landscape

scenes.narration: His mother trotted over and gently reminded him that clouds belong in the sky where they can travel.
scenes.visual: gentle adult sheep nuzzling the little lamb's head lovingly, warm comforting maternal atmosphere

scenes.narration: Sam smiled as he realized he didn't need to hold a cloud to enjoy watching its beauty.
scenes.visual: happy contented smile lying back down on the grass, relaxed woolly body, peaceful afternoon meadow

scenes.narration: Some things are simply meant to be admired from afar.
scenes.visual: closed-eye peaceful expression, resting chin on hooves, soft golden sunlight filtering through pasture grass

scenes.narration: Letting go brings peace to your heart. Follow along for more bedtime stories.
scenes.visual: waving a friendly hoof toward the camera, sleepy smiling face, soft pastel twilight sky background
